info.name: Get all transactions for a wallet

params.name: wallet_address
params.description: The address of the wallet

params.name: integrator
params.description: Filter the transactions by integrator

params.name: fromTimestamp
params.description: A unix timestamp in seconds. No transaction older than this timestamp will be returned. If no value is passed, then the default value will be 30 days prior the current date.

params.name: toTimestamp
params.description: A unix timestamp in seconds. No transaction newer than this timestamp will be returned.

items.docs: This endpoint can be used to get all transactions for a wallet.

info.name: Get a list of filtered transfers

params.name: integrator
params.description: The integrator string to filter by

params.name: wallet
params.description: The sending OR receiving wallet address

params.name: status
params.description: The status of the transfers. Possible values are `ALL`, `DONE`, `PENDING`, and `FAILED`. The default is `DONE`

params.name: fromTimestamp
params.description: The oldest timestamp that should be taken into consideration. Defaults to 30 days ago

params.name: toTimestamp
params.description: The newest timestamp that should be taken into consideration. Defaults to now

params.name: fromChain
params.description: The chain where the transfer originates from.

params.name: toChain
params.description: The chain where the transfer ends.

params.name: fromToken
params.description: The token transferred from the originating chain. To use this parameter `fromChain` must be set.

params.name: toToken
params.description: The token received on the destination chain. To use this parameter `toChain` must be set.

items.docs: This endpoint can be used to retrieve a list of transfers filtered by certain properties. Returns a maximum of 1000 transfers.

info.name: Get the total amount of a token received on a specific chain, for cross-chain transfers.

params.name: limit
params.description: Pagination limit. Defines the maximum number of returned results.

params.name: next
params.description: The next page cursor. Must come from the `next` field of the response of the previous request.

params.name: previous
params.description: The previous page cursor. Must come from the `previous` field of the response of the previous request.

params.name: fromTimestamp
params.description: A Unix timestamp in seconds marking the start of the query period, inclusive. Transactions older than this timestamp will not be included in the summary.

params.name: toTimestamp
params.description: A Unix timestamp in seconds marking the end of the query period, inclusive. Transactions after this timestamp will not be included in the summary. **The maximum range supported by the endpoint is 30 days.**

params.name: toChain
params.description: The ID, or key of the chain on the receiving side of the transfer. This parameter filters the summary to include only transfers received on the specified chain.

params.name: toToken
params.description: The address, or symbol of the token received in the transfers. This parameter filters the summary to include only transfers involving the specified token on the receiving chain.

params.name: fromChain
params.description: The ID, or key of the chain on the sending side of the transfers. This parameter filters the summary to include only transfers sent from the specified chain.

params.name: integrator
params.description: The integrator string to filter transfers by. This parameter filters the summary to include only transfers for the given integrator.

items.docs: Calculates and returns the total received token amount per wallet address, per sending chain, within a specified time range, for a given receiving chain and receiving token. Only aggregates cross-chain transfers, meaning transfers with distinct sending and receiving chains.
